summary:
Hello friends! We're thrilled to share how the Lord has provided for our needs with a new (used) Truck for operations, and with a very generous one-time gift from Creekside, a partner Church. Everyone's support has helped make more projects happen (wheelchair ramp, a new front door for our headquarters, and other things) and continue the core Delivery program. 
Dive into our newsletter to see the amazing work being done in our community and find out how you can join us in making a difference for our neighbors in need!

Hello, friends! To start, We Need A Truck!! Let us know any leads for discounts or donations for a reliable truck (email michael@cccgainesville.org).
In this newsletter, we’re thrilled to share how we are bringing hope through our services (delivery, projects, and more) with love to families in need. Also read about Will's experience as the Home Delivery Coordinator in the letter for this update.

Thanks for all the support, and please share about our ministry with others!

In our latest newsletter, we’re thrilled to share that we have and will continue to expand our home delivery services for neighbors in need and completed several impactful home projects, including two large ramps! Join us as we continue to connect the church with our community and make a difference. Read the full newsletter to see how you can get involved with CCC, with your time, resources, or prayers!
Thank you,
Michael

Summer update from Christians Concerned for the Community: we’re delivering gently used furniture through our Home Delivery program and building accessibility ramps for neighbors in need — Grace at Fort Clarke completed three big projects in one Day of Action. McFall Builders even donated a new roof and new doors for our “Med Shed,” and volunteers are still needed for home projects and deliveries — click to read the full May newsletter and see photos.

Spring update from Christians Concerned for the Community — read how we’re remembering John Perkins’ legacy and celebrating volunteers like Will (Home Delivery) and the Alpha Omega group at CampusView Church who tackled a major yard cleanup. See recent ramp builds and home deliveries, find urgent needs (queen mattresses, pots & pans), and learn easy ways to give or volunteer — click to read Michael Lynch’s full Director’s Letter and get involved.

Read our Annual Report for 2025 to see the work that CCC has accomplished this past year! We are so thankful for all of our partners who make what we do possible, tangibly serving our neighbors in need as in image of God's love.

A brief newsletter giving updates about the year end of CCC! And a belated Merry Christmas! We hope and pray that the light of Christ has warmed the end of the year for everyone as we look forward to this new year.
CCC is expanding operations after our new hire, and we need your support! We're looking for ~$20k more in donations to meet our goal for this year.

Expanded Staff, Engaging with the Church, and the Exile of the local Church. Please read and share about the work and the needs of CCC, as we love our neighbors, as we expand our staff to increase our impact, and as we seek to raise more funds to make all that happen!
